data.one_liner: A Flutter widget providing an animated glowing border effect for rectangular containers.
data.what_it_does: GlowContainer is a Flutter widget that enhances rectangular containers with a customizable, dynamic animated glowing border. It supports customizable glow colors, radius, spread, gradients, and animation duration.
use_when: You want to create eye-catching buttons or cards with an animated glowing border.
You need a customizable rectangular container with gradient glow effects.
avoid_when: You need non-rectangular shapes or complex custom paths that go beyond basic rounded rectangles.
strengths: Customizable glow colors, radius, and spread
Supports gradient glow effects and animated borders
Easy integration with existing Flutter widgets
weaknesses: Provides only a specific visual effect rather than a comprehensive widget library
data.minimal_example:
GlowContainer(
  glowRadius: 20,
  gradientColors: [Colors.blue, Colors.purple, Colors.pink],
  rotationDuration: Duration(seconds: 3),
  containerOptions: ContainerOptions(
    width: 200,
    height: 200,
    borderRadius: 15,
    backgroundColor: Colors.black,
  ),
  child: Center(
    child: Text(
      'Glowing Container',
      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
    ),
  ),
)
